verdict.rationale: Crossplane inherits Kubernetes RBAC and markets itself as exposing declarative APIs 'humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on,' which implies scoped access control is possible via standard k8s RBAC/ServiceAccounts, but there is no concrete documentation of an agent-specific credential-issuance mechanism or least-privilege workflow tailored to AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit agent-facing credential scoping feature, docs on issuing/rotating scoped tokens for agents, and any hands-on or community validation of this specific use case.
